description: This file contains startup classes for configuring Google-related features in an OrchardCore module, including Google Authentication, Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager. It defines service registrations, feature dependencies, and deployment steps.

classes.name: GoogleAuthenticationStartup
classes.description: Configures services for Google Authentication feature.

classes.name: GoogleAnalyticsStartup
classes.description: Configures services for Google Analytics feature.

classes.name: GoogleTagManagerStartup
classes.description: Configures services for Google Tag Manager feature.

classes.name: GoogleAuthenticationDeploymentStartup
classes.description: Sets up deployment step for Google Authentication settings.

classes.name: GoogleAnalyticsDeploymentStartup
classes.description: Sets up deployment step for Google Analytics settings.

classes.name: GoogleTagManagerDeploymentStartup
classes.description: Sets up deployment step for Google Tag Manager settings.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Registers services and configurations for each feature.
